mobbin:f28f8936-895b-450a-8e9b-5a83c12ba.summary: Presenter starts a Live session on the big screen: QR + short code appear for audience join, then the join banner can be hidden while LIVE status stays.
steal: Step 2: Dual join path — large QR plus canva.live + short alphanumeric code for rooms where phones struggle to scan.
Step 2: LIVE (n) participant count next to End session so the host knows handoff succeeded.
Step 2→3: Hide/Show on the join strip clears chrome from the public display after people connect.
Step 2: Copy invitation as a non-QR fallback for remote or delayed joiners.
avoid: Step 2 shows only the big-screen side — no phone notes/remote UI in this flow; weak evidence for private faculty annotations.
mobbin:f28f8936-895b-450a-8e9b-5a83c12ba.fit: Strong pattern for Baseline QR on the debrief-room screen after recording: public display shows video + ephemeral join chrome; phone (not shown here) would hold private annotations.

mobbin:f2fe9686-5232-45d6-816e-8d7d99eae.summary: From a phone presentation view, open remote-control sharing: QR plus copy-link to hand control to another device, with pause-controls.
steal: Step 2: Explicit title 'Remote control this presentation' states the handoff job in one line.
Step 2: Available status + Pause controls lets the host disable the remote link without ending the session.
Step 2: Copy link beside QR covers tablet/phone scanning failures in a debrief room.
avoid: Flow is phone-only — no paired big-screen frame; Baseline needs both sides for strong second-screen evidence.
mobbin:f2fe9686-5232-45d6-816e-8d7d99eae.fit: Maps to faculty phone as private remote for the room display; prefer pairing with the web Live QR flow so both sides of the handoff are designed.
